dct_description_sm:
Rate of mineralization and vegetation of surfaces in the territory of the agglomeration of Montreal represented by polygons and based on the data [Mineral and vegetable surfaces of 2016] (https://donnees.montreal.ca/dataset/surfaces-minerales-vegetales) from the Geomatics Division of the City of Montreal. The data was calculated at the district level and at the level of the distribution islands of Statistics Canada. 

The data can also be consulted on the [interactive climate change vulnerability map] (https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/944e0b7104bd491591ccca829da24670/page/Page/).**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
